title.zh: 将拉乌尼翁省圣费尔南多市宾夕法尼亚大道更名为省长Joaquin L. Ortega大道的法案
title.en: An Act Renaming Pennsylvania Avenue in the City of San Fernando, Province of La Union as Governor Joaquin L. Ortega Avenue
title.orig: An Act Renaming Pennsylvania Avenue in the City of San Fernando, Province of La Union as Governor Joaquin L. Ortega Avenue

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2007/ra_9465_2007.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Pennsylvania Avenue, a secondary national road situated in the City of San Fernando, Province of La Union is hereby renamed as Governor Joaquin L. Ortega Avenue.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
